/Connector Catalog/Microsoft Dynamics365 Bc/Actions

Actions

The Microsoft Dynamics365 Bc connector exposes the following clients:

ClientPurpose
ClientManage companies, customers, vendors, items, sales and purchase documents, journals, general ledger data, financial reports and other Business Central records through the Business Central API v1.0.

Client​

The Client connects to the Business Central API v1.0 (https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com/v2.0/production/api/v1.0). It exposes 324 operations. Most operations are scoped to a company and take its companyId.

http2Settingshttp:ClientHttp2Settings{}Configurations related to HTTP/2 protocol

forwardedstring"disable"The choice of setting forwarded/x-forwarded header
followRedirectshttp:FollowRedirectsOptionalConfigurations associated with Redirection
poolConfighttp:PoolConfigurationOptionalConfigurations associated with request pooling
cachehttp:CacheConfig{}HTTP caching related configurations
compressionhttp:Compressionhttp:COMPRESSION_AUTOSpecifies the way of handling compression (accept-encoding) header
circuitBreakerhttp:CircuitBreakerConfigOptionalConfigurations associated with the behaviour of the Circuit Breaker
retryConfighttp:RetryConfigOptionalConfigurations associated with retrying
cookieConfighttp:CookieConfigOptionalConfigurations associated with cookies
responseLimitshttp:ResponseLimitConfigs{}Configurations associated with inbound response size limits
secureSockethttp:ClientSecureSocketOptionalSSL/TLS-related options
proxyhttp:ProxyConfigOptionalProxy server related options
socketConfighttp:ClientSocketConfig{}Provides settings related to client socket configuration
validationbooleantrueEnables the inbound payload validation functionality which provided by the constraint package. Enabled by default
laxDataBindingbooleantrueEnables relaxed data binding on the client side. When enabled, nil values are treated as optional, and absent fields are handled as nilable types. Enabled by default.

Initializing the client​

import ballerinax/microsoft.dynamics365.bc;

configurable string tenantId = ?;
configurable string clientId = ?;
configurable string clientSecret = ?;
configurable string refreshToken = ?;

final bc:OAuth2RefreshTokenGrantConfig auth = {
    clientId,
    clientSecret,
    refreshToken,
    refreshUrl: string `https://login.microsoftonline.com/${tenantId}/oauth2/v2.0/token`,
    scopes: ["https://api.businesscentral.dynamics.com/Financials.ReadWrite.All", "offline_access"]
};

final bc:Client bcClient = check new ({auth});

Operations​

Companies​

listCompanies

Returns a list of companies.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
headersmap<string|string[]>NoHeaders to be sent with the request. Defaults to {}.
skipintNoThe number of entities to skip before returning the results.
topintNoThe maximum number of entities to return.
filterstringNoAn OData filter expression that restricts the entities returned.
'limitintNoThe maximum number of entities to return in the page.
'select("id"|"systemVersion"|"name"|"displayName"|"businessProfileId")[]NoThe properties to include in the returned entities.

Returns: CompanyCollection|error

Sample code:

bc:CompanyCollection result = check bcClient->listCompanies();

    }
  ]
}

bc:VendorPurchaseCollection result = check bcClient->listVendorPurchases("3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6");

Sample response:

{
  "value": [
    {
      "name": "Sample name",
      "vendorId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
      "dateFilter_FilterOnly": "2026-01-15T00:00:00"
    }
  ]
}
getVendorPurchase

Returns a vendor purchase record.

Parameters:

NameTypeRequiredDescription
companyIdstringYesThe unique identifier of the company.
vendorPurchaseVendorIdstringYesThe vendor id of the vendor purchase.
vendorPurchaseVendorNumberstringYesThe vendor number of the vendor purchase.
vendorPurchaseNamestringYesThe name of the vendor purchase.
headersmap<string|string[]>NoHeaders to be sent with the request. Defaults to {}.
'select("vendorId"|"vendorNumber"|"name"|"totalPurchaseAmount"|"dateFilter_FilterOnly")[]NoThe properties to include in the returned entities.

Returns: VendorPurchase|error

Sample code:

bc:VendorPurchase result = check bcClient->getVendorPurchase("3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6", "INV-0001", "Sample name");

Sample response:

{
  "name": "Sample name",
  "vendorId": "3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6",
  "dateFilter_FilterOnly": "2026-01-15T00:00:00",
  "vendorNumber": "INV-0001",
  "totalPurchaseAmount": 100.00
}
